title: Dallas, TX — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

content:
Overview

Dallas is a city in TX with a population of 1,304,442. Big D offers corporate headquarters, sports, and no state income tax at a reasonable cost. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.4.
